text:
deploy-bot: Canary started by @ashley -> inference-api v3.0.0 at 7% (ap-south-1:4%, eu-central-1:3%). Change window 30m. Watch errors and p99. ID: canary-6288888888
ashley: Beginning active watch. Pause thresholds: 5xx >0.9% or p99 +200ms.
tom: Seeing a jump in ap-south p99 from 220ms -> 560ms in last 5m, p95 OK.
priya: Traces show repeated backend timeout to kv-store on a subset of canary hosts: `kvclient.get(keys) -> timeout 150ms`. Looks tied to new prefetch behavior in v3.0.0.
eng-release-lead: Is it canary-only?
tom: Yes isolated to canary-ap-south hosts; eu-central unaffected.
ashley: Recommend pinning ap-south to v2.9.8 and continue eu-central. Quick thumbs?
priya: +1 pin. I'll add failing traces to RT-4102 and draft a minimal fix to back off prefetch concurrency.
oncall-sre: +1 pin. I'll lower alert sensitivity and watch for escalation.
deploy-bot: Running route-pin --region ap-south-1 --to v2.9.8 --reason "kv-store timeouts on canary"
deploy-bot: Route pin applied. ap-south now routed to v2.9.8 (approx 4% traffic). Canary v3.0.0 continues in eu-central (3%). Rollout ID: canary-6288888888
ashley: Updated release notes with pause in ap-south: https://go/release/2025-04-22#6288888888-notes. Will hold global progression until fix validated.
eng-release-lead: Open RT-4102 and include heap/profile dumps. If PR merges and QA green we can re-roll within the window. Reconvene in 30m.
